mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing present valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active in all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in non-farm payrolls signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the previous quarter signals weakening demand for housing, a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 115.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating a supply-side shock that reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 115.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust demand for residential construction, which correlates with higher consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals delayed monetary policy response to inflation, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high CPI and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a stalling labor market recovery, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during post-recession recoveries when UNRATE rises.
